remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x601)

# fltmc.exe is all Rust (fltmc-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/fltmc-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# fltmc.cpp is replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/fltmc-rust/src/fltmc/fltmc.rs, `rustconv port`);
# the C++ stays on disk. The target keeps a stub TU and links the Rust archive, which takes
# ATL's CStringW from atl-rust -- so no cpprt/atl_classes, and user32 for its LoadStringW.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(fltmc_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(fltmc_shims PRIVATE libfltlib libmsvcrt libkernel32 libadvapi32 libuser32)
target_compile_definitions(fltmc_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(fltmc fltmc-cargo fltmc.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE fltmc-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS fltmc_shims psdk)
